Since the ad campaign launched, the edge cache hit-rate has cratered and the CDN bill nearly doubled - origin egress is spiking on pages that should be cached. Separately, two customers report seeing someone else's experiment variant on pages our analytics says belong to the other cohort. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py. Fix cache_key so equivalent requests share a cache entry, without breaking existing behaviour.

Stacked discounts compute the wrong total. Two 50% discounts on $100 give $0 instead of $25 - they're applied to the original amount in parallel instead of compounding. Fix apply_discounts so stacked discounts combine correctly. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py.

A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py. Fix drain_order so the shutdown plan matches the drain policy, without breaking existing behaviour.

Reassigning a repeated query parameter doesn't drop the old values. URL query params are an OrderedMultiDict, and for URL('http://x/?a=1&a=2'), after query_params['a'] = '9', getlist('a') returns ['1', '2', '9'] instead of ['9'] — the old values linger. It only shows up via getlist; url['a'] and round-tripping look fine. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py. Fix it without breaking existing behaviour.

A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py. Fix overage_charge so invoices follow the metering policy, without breaking existing behaviour.

slugify is mangling product titles that contain symbols. 'R&D' slugifies to 'r-d' — the '&' is dropped entirely, which changed the search term and tanked the page's ranking. Symbols in titles (&, $, %) need to be preserved as the team's standard words in the slug, not stripped. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py. Fix boltons.strutils.slugify without breaking its existing behaviour.
